qualification_gates: Manufacturer datasheet pinout and exposed-pad geometry match every canonical U11 pad; a package-name match is insufficient.
SPI command set, initialization, busy behavior, capacity reporting and power-loss recovery pass the same firmware tests without a part-specific manual process.
Complete-device 16h battery integral, storage startup/write peak and 30h encrypted retention pass on five units.
JLC stock and Standard-only assembly eligibility are rechecked immediately before release.
BOM, CPL, firmware-supported-device list and release manifest identify the actually fitted MPN.
not_claimed: Neither alternate is proven pin-compatible from the currently captured public catalog data.
No alternate has passed firmware or physical EVT.
Observed inventory is not reserved and does not prove long-term supply.
